_comment: Document package bundles. Each package defines a named set of templates, shared instance inputs, and cross-reference rules. When a user requests a package, all documents are generated in a single flow with consistent data.

packages.name: Client Onboarding Pack
packages.description: Full onboarding set for a new client. Covers the commercial conversation (proposal), the legal handshake (NDA), and the work definition (SOW) — all cross-referenced and consistently dated.

shared_inputs.label: Scope of work (describe in plain English)

cross_references: The SOW scope section must exactly match the scope described in the Proposal
The NDA is dated the same day as the Proposal and references the same project title
The Proposal investment section references 'full scope detailed in the SOW'
All three documents use the same client_name, fee_total, and governing law from context library
packages.generation_order_reason: NDA first (shortest, no content dependency), then Proposal (sets the commercial framing), then SOW (inherits scope and fee from Proposal)

packages.name: Deal Close Pack
packages.description: The documents needed to formally close and kick off a signed deal: a Contract (with the SOW attached as Exhibit A) and an updated Price List.
cross_references: The Contract references the SOW as Exhibit A and includes a line: 'Scope of services is defined in Exhibit A attached hereto'
The fee schedule in the Contract matches the Price List exactly
The SOW milestone dates align with start_date and end_date in the Contract
All three documents use the same client_name, fee_total, governing law, and payment terms
packages.generation_order_reason: SOW first (defines scope), Price List second (sets fees), Contract last (incorporates both as references)

packages.name: New Business Pack
packages.description: Sales collateral for pitching a new prospect: a Pitch Deck for the meeting, a Price List to leave behind, and a Case Study relevant to their industry.
cross_references: The Pitch Deck closing slide references the Price List: 'Full pricing available in the attached sheet'
The Case Study selected should be from the same or a closely adjacent industry to the prospect
The services featured in the Pitch Deck match the line items shown in the Price List
If the prospect's name is known, personalise the Pitch Deck cover with their company name
packages.generation_order_reason: Case Study first (confirm which one is most relevant), Price List second (confirm what's being pitched), Pitch Deck last (references both)

packages.name: Project Kickoff Pack
packages.description: Everything needed to start a project smoothly: SOW (the contract for the work), a recurring Status Update template, and a Runbook for the operational workflow.
cross_references: The Status Update template's 'Milestones' section is pre-populated with the milestones from the SOW
The Runbook's 'Project Contacts' section references the client name and internal leads from the SOW
All three documents use the same project_title and client_name
packages.generation_order_reason: SOW first (defines all project details), Runbook second (uses SOW context for procedures), Status Update last (inherits milestones from SOW)
